limits: Every figure is listed metadata from OpenRouter, captured at the moment shown. It is what a host advertises, not what a request measured.
Prices and host counts move within hours. On 10 August one model's price spread went from 6.25x to 9.36x in seven hours with no change in host count.
Hosts are named as the two ends of a spread. That is a price fact, not a judgement about quality, and nothing here ranks a host.
This says nothing about whether a host serves the model well. Listed and healthy are not the same as accurate.
